data.body: F47 research passed signed completion verification, then required a renewed plan review because its description text had changed after the original review. The renewed review passed with one advisory, which was deferred because the completed empirical conclusion is supported by the recorded sources. The second close attempt reran completion verification and closed cuddlesome-amoral-oyster without force. Enrich drain gate checks during these operations took 21 to 26 milliseconds and did not account for the multi minute LLM calls.
